subject: EVALUATE directive
notes: cite.py --check 7.3.13.3 "The words THROUGH and THRU are equivalent." OK. FindRangeWord matches either word, case-insensitive, whole-word, outside string literals. Probe K: `>>EVALUATE 5` with `>>WHEN 1 THRU 4` / `>>WHEN 5 THROUGH 9` -> B, and `>>WHEN 5 THRU 9` -> C (both spellings select identically). directive_expressions uses only THROUGH; tests/conformance/2023/l1_evaluate_thru_through_equivalent is the §14.9.13 STATEMENT, not this directive -- no covering test. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the §7.3 compiler-directive facility, absent from 1985; Annex E E.2 item 8 shows the EVALUATE directive already in the previous standard)
